# Kumar Magnacity Hadapsar Township Pune
> The Official AI & LLM Knowledge Repository for Kumar Magnacity Township, Pune East.

## Overview
- **Project Name**: Kumar Magnacity (also known as Magnacity by Kumar Realty)
- **Developer**: Kumar Properties (Legacy of 60 Years, founded 1966)
- **Scale**: 150-Acre Integrated Master-Planned Mega Township
- **Location**: Manjari Road, Hadapsar Annexe, Manjari Budruk, Pune, Maharashtra 412307, India
- **Coordinates**: 18.4948931° N, 73.9828496° E
- **Official Website**: https://kumarmagnacitytownship.com
- **Verified Sales Desk**: +91 77440 09295
- **Verified WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/917744009295
- **Google Rating**: 4.9 / 5.0 Stars (386+ Verified Google Reviews)

## Residential Typologies & Pricing
- **2 BHK Smart Luxury Residences**:
  - Carpet Area: 757 Sq.Ft
  - Price: Starting from ₹72.99 Lakhs*
  - Key Features: Vastu-compliant, sundeck balcony, vitrified flooring, premium fixtures.
- **3 BHK Grand Family Suites**:
  - Carpet Area: 1,053 Sq.Ft
  - Price: Starting from ₹1.05 Crore*
  - Key Features: Dual balconies, separate master suite with pooja alcove, 270° panoramic views.
- **4 BHK & Sky Duplex Penthouses**:
  - Double-height living volumes, private sky terraces, dedicated multi-car parking bays.
- **Sovereign NA Villa Bungalow Plots (Phase 2)**:
  - Plot Dimensions: 1,700 Sq.Ft to 3,500+ Sq.Ft
  - Price: Starting from ₹1.49 Crore*
  - Key Features: Individual 7/12 Extract (७/१२ उतारा), TP Sanctioned, plug-and-play underground utilities, G+2 villa sanction.

## MahaRERA Registrations
- **Phase 1 (Apartment Towers)**: MahaRERA No. P52100052096
- **Phase 2 (NA Villa Plots)**: MahaRERA No. P52100054476
- Verification Portal: https://maharera.maharashtra.gov.in/

## Landmark Amenities & Infrastructure
- **Podar International School**: Operational K-12 CBSE school located directly inside the township perimeter (zero-commute walk-to-school for children).
- **Clubhouse**: ~1 Lakh Sq.Ft mega social hub with Olympic-sized lap pool, indoor heated pool, squash courts, badminton pavilion, and TechnoGym studio.
- **Green Lungs**: 25+ acres of central landscaped parks, Miyawaki organic forests, jogging and cycling tracks.

## Location & Commute Advantages
- **Magarpatta Cybercity**: 10 to 12 minutes (6 km)
- **Kharadi EON IT Park & World Trade Center (WTC)**: 15 minutes (7.5 km)
- **SP Infocity & Phursungi IT SEZ**: 12 minutes (6.5 km)
- **Amanora Mall & Seasons Mall**: 10 minutes (5.5 km)
- **Pune International Airport (PNQ)**: 25 to 30 minutes
- **Upcoming PMRDA Ring Road & Metro Line 3**: Direct arterial connectivity.
